blocks.text: Polymers large (bare) inorganic ya organic molecules hain jin ki properties unique (khaas) hain. Organic polymers kahin zyada aam hain, lekin kuch khaas kaamon mein inorganic polymers organic polymers se zyada ahem hain. Polymers apni pasand ke alag alag chhote molecules se banaye jate hain. Polymers ki poori detail (tafseel) Chapter 26 mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Polymers kis cheez se banaye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhote molecules (monomers) se, jo aapas mein jur kar bohat bare molecules bana dete hain.

items: Polymers: chhote molecules se bane bare organic ya inorganic molecules (detail Chapter 26 mein).
